item: HCR-3 (count rule for the high space)
machine: Apple Silicon (arm64 darwin, 128 GB), Python 3.11, numpy 1.26.4, mlx 0.32.5, mlx-lm 0.32.2 (scratch install, removed after), fastembed bge-small-en-v1.5 for the lean arm
method: HOT-8's method on the real warm 4B. Each corpus copied to a temp project; lean index built with bge-small, the high twin by the same build_index inside embed_mlx.using_space. band target: eval_floor._top_and_gap (the expected memory's gap under the query's best cosine; p75 is the band the sweep recommends). Hook mode: the real hook body (recall_hook.run_recall, hook=True) per prompt, a fresh session each (no cooldown, no spent budget), inside the high space with the index loader pointed at the high twin, as recall_warm_high.serving does. A hard-set hit is the expected memory on a rendered pointer line of the injected block; served rows are the non-collapsed rows on rendered lines. 'off' is the code as 190ed99 left it (no 4B entry; identical to HIPPO_SIGNAL_COUNT=0). Each grid cell patches one {band, wide} in; 'shipped' reads the committed table entry. Explicit mode (recall() with index + index_dir, k=10) is HCR-3's own acceptance measure, re-run first to validate this rig: it reproduces HCR-3's numbers exactly. No ambient HIPPO_* variables (clean env), user tier off, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1.

corpora_note.golden: QUA-6 golden corpus, tests/golden_corpus/ (50 memories, 50 body chunks; hard_set.yaml 18 rows; abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora_note.packs: the CI starter-pack corpus seeded per tests/fixtures/recall_hard_set.yaml's header (22 memories, 65 chunks; that fixture's 32 rows; tests/fixtures/recall_abstention_set.yaml 6 probes). Public.
corpora_note.hippo: this repo's own .claude/memory (108 memories, 272 chunks) with its project-local fixtures (38 rows: 16 single-hop + 22 multi-hop; 11 hand-authored off-topic probes). PRIVATE (gitignored): counts and cosines only, no queries or memory names.

extra_off_topic_probes: HCR-3's 12 generic + 12 adjacent technical probes, unchanged (listed in planning/HCR-3.evidence.2026-11-25.json)
replayed_prompts_note: the 300 newest distinct human prompts of this repo's own episode log, replayed read-only on the live-corpus copy. PRIVATE: counts and histograms only, no prompt text.

grid_hook_mode_high.note: label is band/wide; every cell is hook mode on the high arm. First grid without the replay, second with it (live corpus only).

lean_reference_hook_mode.note: bge-small with its own entry (band 0.05, wide 0.18) on and off, same corpora, same hook measure

rationale.rule: add the entry only if it costs no hard-set row on any of the three corpora
rationale.band: p75 of the expected-memory gap is 0.0 (golden), 0.0547 (packs), 0.124 (live). 0.12 is the live corpus's, the largest; doctor's band check allows 0.01 under the sweep's number. Every band under 0.12 cut one expected starter-pack row at every wide tried, including 0.10.
rationale.wide: 0.14 is the largest margin over the 0.42 floor that cut no row (0.15 cut one starter-pack row; 0.22 one live row; 0.30 two to three on each). On-topic best cosines sit a median 0.27 over the floor (p10 0.145, min 0.075); every off-topic best is at most 0.035 over it. So the narrow rule applies to the weakest tenth of on-topic prompts and to anything that leaks.
rationale.not_chosen: wide 0.30 brings the live hard set's median to 5 rows (lean's reading) but costs 2 rows on packs and 2 on the live corpus at band 0.12; refused by the rule above.

findings: Hard sets, hook mode, high: 18/18, 31/32, 26/38 with the entry and without it; no row lost, none gained. MRR 0.9583 = 0.9583, 0.7852 vs 0.7826, 0.5238 = 0.5238.
Abstention unchanged on all three corpora and all three probe sets (the rule never empties an admitted prompt).
Rows served on off-topic probes that leak on the live corpus: 75 -> 38 over the 10 leaking probes (7.5 -> 3.8 per leak). Golden 2 -> 1. Packs leak none.
Rows per injecting prompt on the hard sets (on-topic prompts): golden 4.50 = 4.50, packs 5.59 -> 5.38, live 9.79 -> 9.53. Medians unchanged (4, 5, 10).

300 replayed prompts on the live corpus, high: 269 inject either way; rows per injecting prompt 9.41 -> 8.06 (2,530 -> 2,169 rows, -14%), chars 1,575 -> 1,397; the median stays 10. 183 of the 269 clear the floor by 0.14 and are served as before.

Lean on the same replay: 227 inject; 9.68 -> 5.23 rows, median 10 -> 5, chars 1,575 -> 1,021. High injects on 42 more of the 300 prompts than lean and, with a no-row-lost entry, serves more rows on each.
Lean's own entry under this hook measure: golden 18/18 = 18/18, live 26/38 = 26/38, starter packs 29/32 off -> 24/32 on. Recorded, not changed here.

Hook mode reads lower than explicit mode on the live corpus for both arms (high 26/38 vs 31/38; lean 26/38 vs 33/38): the hook's lanes, render budget and floor collapse, with the count rule on or off.

not_calibrated.Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B: weights not fetched; no floor, gate or count entry. Doctor names it.
not_calibrated.MRL-truncated spaces (model@dim): different cosine spaces; a width needs its own run once HCR-6's bench picks one. Doctor names it.

with_warm_reranker.note: Re-run after HCR-4 (#237) landed, on main at bc1839d plus this change: the same hook-mode measure with the warm reranker (Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B) active, as recall_warm_high.serving runs a high-profile call once the reranker has loaded. HIPPO_RERANK_TIMEOUT raised so every call is reranked; a production call that passes the 0.8 s warm bound falls back to the fused order, which is the case the rest of this file measures. So the entry has to cost no row in both orders, and it does.
findings: Entry 0.12/0.14 with the reranker on: hard sets 18/18, 31/32, 25/38 on and off, MRR identical; rows on leaked off-topic probes 94 -> 49 over the three corpora; replay 9.57 -> 8.13 rows per injecting prompt.

With the reranker on, wide up to 0.22 also costs no row (replay median 5, mean 6.28); without it wide 0.15 already cuts a starter-pack row. The entry stays at 0.14 because a call that times out is served in the fused order.
The reranker itself, count rule off, hook mode: golden MRR 0.958 -> 1.000; starter packs 0.783 -> 0.765; live corpus 26/38 -> 25/38 and MRR 0.524 -> 0.459.
